<u>**Data Science/Bioinformatics Learning Objectives:**</u>

1. Import selected-model CoGAPS artifacts, metadata tables, diagnostics, and manifest files in R or Python.
1. Summarize cell-level pattern scores, gene-level loadings, and run diagnostics as tidy analysis tables.
1. Join CoGAPS cell scores to subject, timepoint, and broad immune-cell-type annotations.
1. Create reproducible summaries and visualizations from small teaching artifacts included with the case study.
1. Explain which artifacts are included with the case study and which large reproduction files belong in the Zenodo archive.
